title: Proposal: Research of the Week (ROTW)
author: fisj
selftext: There’s been some great posts already from redditors here, but I want to try a few things to foster more in depth discussions. One suggestion I had was “Research of the Week”, where we agree on a topic ahead of time and each week we pile on and add research and discuss. Please suggest topics below. It would be nice to have a good dozen hashed out before we pick one for next week. Here’s some initial suggestions: * LevelDiffusion - What would an AI assisted level design tool look like? What technologies exist that could be combined with it? How would we get training data? Maybe this is too big a topic and needs to be broken down into subtopics? * CharacterDiffusion - Things like metahumans exist, but you bet \_someone\_ is working on a 3d diffusion solution for characters. This is a space ripe for disruption, since SD is doing such a crazy good job already, but also the latent space of humans is relatively confined and there’s plenty of data. * MaterialDiffusion - SD has texture generation working, and it also seems to have models for lighting and various material properties like sub surface somewhere in it. Can SD be extended to produce high quality materials with the full range of properties we want. Anisotropy, Normals, SSS, different BSDFs etc. * BarrelDiffusion - Can we build narrow generators for various items we consider ubiquitous? I used barrel as a joke example, but instead of making a broad generalist 3d diffusion model, can we make things more tractable with focusing on a single thing? Rocks maybe? * Game Engines and Generative AI - What game engines are best suited for generative AI. How does generative AI fit into the pipeline? Also maybe super broad and needs to be broken down into subtopics. ​ https://preview.redd.it/iyeneuapbwka1.png?width=128&format=png&auto=webp&v=enabled&s=78758022e50c87324ab67b253ff6f750d33aae95 PS.
